name: ad-creative
description: Generate finished static ads for a brand in your Great Ads AI workspace. The static-ad skill writes one on-brand angle + headline from your brand's voice, lets you pick a style from your Style Library, and Great Ads AI renders the finished 4:5 + 9:16 ad on its hosted AI and saves it to your pipeline as a Ready-For-Review card. All generation runs on the Great Ads AI hosted API — no AI provider keys of your own, billed to your credits.

connectors.description: Great Ads AI hosted API. The skill reads your brand's voice/styles and renders + saves the finished ad — all on Great Ads AI's servers and AI models, billed to your workspace credits. Generate the key in the Great Ads AI dashboard under Settings → Integrations → Connect to Claude.

vars.description: Your Great Ads AI workspace API key (starts with gaa_live_). The ONLY credential the skill needs.

setup.claude_code: Add both vars to ~/.config/great-marketing-ai/great-marketing-ai.env (the Connect-to-Claude dialog in the dashboard gives you a ready-to-paste block).
